battle.name: 隋煬帝第二次攻高麗之戰
battle.brief: 大業九年正月，隋煬帝再發大軍征高句麗，九軍三十萬五千人渡鴨綠水，圍平壤月餘，築土山攻城不下，糧盡北還，途中遇雨缺糧，賴玄菟長史史祥築城拒追兵。卡面羅馬標槍早七百餘年，僅作重投槍破騎的形制對照；隋軍近身所恃仍是槊、排甲與百日糧。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是隋朝，一方是高句麗。隋方在大業九年正月下詔，從天下各道調兵，集結於幽州涿郡，並把早年為備東征而興建的六合城當作屯糧、屯兵與集結輜重的樞紐；作戰編制仍循大業八年的舊例，兵分左右各十二軍共二十四道，每軍設大將、亞將各一人，騎兵四十隊（每隊百人，十隊為團），步卒八十隊分為四團、每團設偏將一人，輜重散兵另編四團由步卒挾帶行軍，鎧冑、纓拂、旗幡按團各異色，進止立營皆有定制；御營合十一衛、三台、五省、九寺，分隸內外前後左右六軍，出兵時每人給百日糧，並給排甲、槍槊、衣資、戎具與火幕。統軍者是行軍元帥宇文述，封德彝在軍中參贊軍務，樂浪道主將于仲文等分道並進。高句麗一方以國都平壤與鴨綠水天險為核心，國王高元坐鎮平壤，鴨綠水一線的遲滯、詐降與追擊由往來兩軍的高句麗譯使乙支文德周旋，邊城與山道哨所由各城主分守；百濟仍在國境上整兵，與高句麗暗通聲氣，實際持兩端。
countriesEn: The two parties in this war were the Sui dynasty and the kingdom of Goguryeo. In the first month of the ninth year of Daye (613) the Sui issued the mobilisation orders, drawing troops from the circuits of the realm into Zhuo Commandery in You prefecture, and treated the Liuhé city built years earlier to prepare for a campaign in the east as the pivot for storing grain, quartering troops and mustering baggage. The organisation of the army followed the precedent set in the eighth year of Daye: the troops were divided into a left and a right group of twelve armies each, twenty-four columns in all; each army had one commander and one deputy, forty cavalry units of a hundred men each with ten units to a regiment, eighty infantry units divided into four regiments with an officer over each, and four more regiments of baggage troops and stragglers carried along by the infantry; armour, plumes and banners were coloured differently for every regiment, and there was a fixed order of advance, halt and encampment. The imperial camp combined the eleven guards, the three platforms, the five ministries and the nine temples across the inner, outer, front, rear, left and right armies, and every man was given a hundred days of grain together with laminated armour, spears and mao, clothing, accoutrements and fire-screens. The command was in the hands of the field marshal Yuwen Shu, with Feng Deyi in the army as an adviser, while Yu Zhongwen on the Lelang road and other commanders moved forward by separate routes. Goguryeo based itself on the capital of Pyongyang and the natural barrier of the Yalu. The king, Gao Yuan, remained in Pyongyang, and the delaying, the feigned surrenders and the pursuit along the Yalu were managed by Yizhi Wende, a Goguryeo interpreter who travelled between the two armies; the frontier cities and the posts in the mountain passes were held by their own local commanders. Baekje still mustered troops along its own frontier and kept in secret contact with Goguryeo, holding in fact to both sides.
people: 這一役的關鍵人物，多半不是死在陣上，而是死在往返的文書與等待的回報裡。隋煬帝楊廣在正月下詔再征，親赴涿郡督師，把百萬之師的勝負壓在一次速戰速決上；出師前的勸阻他一概不聽，請緩、請先儲糧的奏疏都被壓下，退兵之後聞報大怒，把宇文述、封德彝等一體貶官，卻因宇文述素有寵於帝、其子宇文士及尚帝女南陽公主而不忍誅之。行軍元帥宇文述是成敗的關鍵：他統九軍渡鴨綠水，節節推進至平壤城下，築土山晝夜攻之，攻之十九日不下，士卒死者相積，軍中糧盡不得不引還，又在途中聽信乙支文德詐降之辭而罷圍，過清河、淺水營時人馬疲病，追兵已及，賴玄菟郡長史史祥築城拒守，眾軍才得脫身。譯使乙支文德是本局的真正主導者：他以一封假報稱扶餘王將發兵五萬來救，說動了圍城大軍解圍北還，又追至清河逐北，終於把隋軍的銳氣與糧秣一同耗盡。樂浪道主將于仲文因逗留被劾，詔免其官。與此同時，隋朝真正的內患在後方爆發：大業九年七月，煬帝從孫楊玄感在黎陽起兵，打出除無道的旗號，旬日之間聚眾十萬，隋將樊子蓋追討，楊玄感兵敗被殺，成為隋朝崩潰的先聲。
peopleEn: The decisive figures in this campaign were for the most part not those who fell on the field, but those who were killed by the messengers running up and down and the reports that had to be waited for. Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang, issued the order for a second campaign in the first month, went in person to Zhuo to direct the host, and staked the fate of a million men on a single stroke of speed. He listened to none of the counsel that came before the march: memorials asking to delay or to store grain in advance were pushed aside. When the news of the withdrawal reached him he was furious and stripped Yuwen Shu, Feng Deyi and the rest of their offices in one stroke, yet he could not bring himself to execute Yuwen Shu, who had long been in favour, because Yuwen Shu's son Yuwen Shi had married the emperor's daughter, the Princess Nanyang. Yuwen Shu, the field marshal, was the hinge of the whole operation: he led nine armies across the Yalu, advanced step by step to the walls of Pyongyang, raised a rampart of earth and attacked it day and night; the assault was carried on for nineteen days without success, the dead piled up among the ranks, and when the grain in the camp ran out the army had to be withdrawn. Then, on the road back, he believed the word of Yizhi Wende's feigned surrender and broke off the siege, and by the time the army passed the Qinghe and the camp at Qianshui the men and horses were worn out and sick, the pursuit had caught up, and only the building of a fort by Shi Xiang, governor of Xuantu Commandery, allowed the survivors to break away. Yizhi Wende, the Goguryeo interpreter, was the real director of the piece: with a single false report, that the king of Buyeo would bring fifty thousand men to the rescue, he talked the besieging army into lifting the siege and turning north, and then he pursued them to the Qinghe, until the edge and the grain of the Sui army were spent together. Yu Zhongwen, who commanded on the Lelang road, was impeached for delay and removed from his command by edict. Meanwhile the real internal danger of the Sui broke out in the rear: in the seventh month of the ninth year of Daye, Yang Xuanggan, a cousin of the emperor, rose in revolt at Liyang under the banner of destroying the tyrannical government, gathered a hundred thousand men within ten days, was pursued by the Sui general Fan Zikai, and was defeated and killed, becoming the first sign of the collapse of the dynasty.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍是公元前一百年前後的兵器：半米長的投槍，槍幹中空，捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。它距大業九年的鴨綠水有七百餘年，不可能出現在這條戰線上；它在本役的位置，是作為重投槍破騎兵這一戰術原理的對照物：羅馬步兵把標槍成束攜帶，在數十步內擲出，專打衝鋒的敵騎與結陣的盾牆，標槍雖短，傷了馬腿馬就倒地，人也就失去衝力；斷在中空的槍桿上，拔不出、帶不走，於是標槍是一種一次性的消耗品，必須靠每人攜帶的數量來補足，這與隋朝一人背著百日糧、走數千里轉輸的體系剛好是兩個極端。隋軍此役真正上陣的裝備另是一套：近身是槊與長矛，排甲與鎧冑護身，蹶張弩、十字弩與弓矢列於後陣，攻城則靠飛樓、橦、雲梯、地道四面俱進，衝梯竿長十五丈，另有投石機拋石毀牆；營具是帳幕、火幕、旌旗與鼓角，糧秣是百日糧配車船轉輸。高句麗那邊靠的是長弓大矢、札甲與精騎的迂迴射擊，木製雲梯與穴地工程用於守城。兩軍在鴨綠水與平壤之間，比的不只是人數，還有每人背上的重量與攻城器械的工藝。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card is a weapon of about the year 100 BC: a throwing spear of half a metre with a hollow shaft, which snaps after it has pierced a shield so that the enemy can only drag himself back behind his cover with half a spear still in him. It stands more than seven hundred years before the Yalu in the ninth year of Daye and could not have been on this front; its place in this campaign is as a comparison of the tactical principle of the heavy throwing spear against cavalry: the Roman infantry carried the pilum in bundles, threw them within a few dozen paces, and aimed them at charging horses and at shield walls. The pilum was short, but a horse that was wounded went down, and the rider lost the momentum of his charge; the shaft broke off inside the hollow neck and could neither be pulled out nor carried away, so the pilum was a consumable thrown away after one use and had to be made up by the number each man carried, which is the exact opposite of the Sui system, where a single soldier carried a hundred days of grain and the line of supply ran for thousands of li. The equipment the Sui army actually carried here was a different system again: the mao and the long spear at close quarters, laminated armour and mail for protection, the crossbow, the heavy crossbow and the bow-and-arrow in the rear; for the assault, flying towers, ramming beams, cloud ladders and tunnels pushed in on all four sides, an assault ladder fifteen zhang long, and stone-throwing engines hurling boulders at the walls; for the camp, tents, fire-screens, banners, drums and horns; and for supply, a hundred days of grain carried by wagon and boat. Goguryeo relied on its own tradition: long bows with heavy arrows, lamellar armour, and the shooting of skilled cavalry from the flank; wooden ladders and tunnel works served the defence of the city. Between the two sides, on the Yalu and at Pyongyang, the contest was not only one of numbers but also of the weight each man carried and of the craftsmanship of the siege engines.
tactics: 隋軍的戰術框架是分道並進、限期會合：二十四道大軍自涿郡分道出發，宇文述等九軍共三十萬五千人渡鴨綠水，分路掃清沿線城邑，目標是合兵平壤城下四面俱攻。這一套在上一年曾經奏效於遼水與瀘河，但本役的敵手換了打法：高句麗不與隋軍決戰於城下，而是閉城死守、據山守險，讓隋軍在城牆下把力量耗盡。攻城技術的落後暴露無遺：隋軍築土山以填城濠、加高至可俯瞰城中，晝夜不停地攻，卻始終拿不下城頭；雲梯、橦車、地道、衝梯同時上處而不能協同，攻具的數量與工藝都頂不住守軍的反制。撤退更形混亂：糧盡而退、遇雨浸濕、士卒多病、軍中乏食，隊形在鴨綠水沿岸解體，乙支文德率追兵在清河追上來，隋軍一路且戰且走，最後靠史祥在淺水營築城固守才把追兵頂住，把撤下來的殘部收攏回渡口。高句麗的戰術是一整套以空間換時間的消耗法：拒渡、依城、詐降、疲敵、追擊，五步一環，環環相扣，把隋軍的絕對優勢一點一點兌換成糧秣、銳氣與士氣的耗損，最後在對方最脆弱的退路上收網。
tacticsEn: The tactical framework of the Sui army was advance by separate routes with an appointed moment of convergence: the twenty-four columns left Zhuo by different roads, and nine armies under Yuwen Shu, numbering three hundred and five thousand men, crossed the Yalu and swept the towns along the line, with the object of joining forces beneath Pyongyang and assaulting the city on all four sides at once. This plan had worked against the Liao and the Luhe the year before, but on this occasion the enemy changed its way of fighting: Goguryeo did not offer battle beneath the walls, but shut the city, held the ground and waited, letting the Sui army exhaust itself against the ramparts. The backwardness of the siegecraft was laid bare: the Sui raised a rampart of earth to fill the ditch and to rise high enough to look down into the city, and attacked it day and night, yet never took the wall; cloud ladders, ramming beams, tunnels and assault ladders were all brought up at the same time without coordination, and neither the number nor the workmanship of the engines could answer the counter-blows of the defenders. The withdrawal was more confused still: the army withdrew because the grain was gone, the men were soaked by rain, many fell sick, there was little to eat, and the order broke down along the Yalu; Yizhi Wende brought the pursuit up at the Qinghe, the Sui fought its way on and on, and only the fort that Shi Xiang built at the camp of Qianshui held the pursuers off and allowed the broken remnants to be rallied back to the crossing. The tactics of Goguryeo were a complete technique of trading space for time: refusing the crossing, holding the city, feigning surrender, wearing the enemy out, pursuing him. Five moves in one chain, each linked to the next, converting the Sui advantage step by step into the exhaustion of grain, of the edge of the army and of its morale, and finally closing the net on the road of retreat, where the other side was weakest.
data: 可查的數字大致如下。出兵之眾，《資治通鑑》記隋煬帝大業九年正月發兵百餘萬、號稱二百萬，較上一年的一百一十三萬三千八百人更多；《隋書》記宇文述、封德彝等九軍凡三十萬五千人渡鴨綠水，分道並進；各書所記兵額，有指全國出師之眾者，有指渡鴨綠水與攻城之眾者，數字互有出入，引用時當先分清所數何者。攻城一項，《隋書》記攻之月餘不下、死者相積，《資治通鑑》記築土山後攻之十九日，而所費以萬億計，土山頂高於城數丈、可俯視城中。糧秣方面，出師時仍是每人給百日糧，另給排甲、槍槊、衣資、戎具與火幕。撤退階段的數字最為刺眼：值雨，人馬浸濕，士卒多病，軍中乏食，追兵及於清河、淺水營，賴史祥築城拒守才得脫身；自平壤退回鴨綠水沿岸約二百里上下。時間線上，正月出師，春夏之間圍城與敗退，七月楊玄感在黎陽起兵，八月之後煬帝回師專意平叛，九月之後論罪貶官。收穫方面則是一無所有：平壤未下，遼東未取，沿線所置郡縣一仍其舊。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. On the strength of the army, the Zizhi Tongjian records that in the first month of the ninth year of Daye the emperor mustered more than a million men, nominally two hundred thousand, more than the one million one hundred and thirty-three thousand eight hundred of the year before; the Suishu records that the nine armies of Yuwen Shu, Feng Deyi and the rest, three hundred and five thousand men in all, crossed the Yalu and advanced by separate routes. The figures for the strength of the army differ between the sources, some of them counting the whole host mustered for the campaign and others only the men who crossed the Yalu and took part in the siege, so any number quoted has to be tied to what it counts. On the siege, the Suishu records that the assault went on for more than a month without success and the dead piled up, while the Zizhi Tongjian records that after the rampart of earth was raised the assault was carried on for nineteen days, that the cost was reckoned in tens of millions, and that the top of the earthwork stood several zhang above the wall so that the city could be looked down into. On supply, the rules of the march were unchanged: a hundred days of grain per man, together with laminated armour, spears and mao, clothing, accoutrements and fire-screens. The figures of the withdrawal are the most cutting of all: the army met with rain, men and horses were soaked, many fell sick, there was little to eat, the pursuit came up at the Qinghe and the camp at Qianshui, and only the fort built by Shi Xiang allowed the army to break away; the distance back from Pyongyang to the banks of the Yalu was about two hundred li. On the chronology: the army set out in the first month, the siege and the defeat fell in the spring and summer, Yang Xuanggan rose at Liyang in the seventh month, the emperor turned back after the eighth month to put the rebellion down, and the sentence on the generals and their demotions followed in the ninth. As for results, there were none at all: Pyongyang was not taken, Liaodong was not taken, and the commanderies and counties set up along the line remained exactly as they were.
cause: 打起來的緣由，一半是前一年的恥，一半是眼前的算計。開皇十八年（598）第一次伐高句麗大敗，煬帝即位後把這筆帳算在東北，視之為新朝奇恥；大業八年（612）百十三萬之師折戟薩水，退兵時只帶回數千殘卒，這一頁是他最難向群臣交代的一頁。再征的理由表面是高句麗梗阻：高句麗不奉詔令，扼住鴨綠水與遼東山地，控著通往渤海、靺鞨的孔道，隋朝的信使與物資都要過境，於是這樣一個邊國在煬帝看來是不能容忍的。但更現實的一層在國內：連年大徵發，河北山東已疲，山東大旱疫癘、盜賊四起，隋廷需要一場勝仗來證明兵制的力量；而煬帝的心性也不接受再等一年，他開皇末年曾對群臣說，若用兵得當，拔山移海不難，面對一個小國自然更不難。於是正月出兵，號稱二百萬，走的是一條用數量壓死對方的路。戰前判斷的漏洞也正在這裡：隋廷仍以為高句麗是待宰的軟骨頭，卻忘記了上一年最要命的兩件事，攻城器械不夠精熟、糧道拉得太長。
causeEn: The reasons for going to war were half the shame of the previous year and half a calculation of the present. The first campaign against Goguryeo in the eighteenth year of Kaihuang (598) had ended in a rout, and once he came to the throne Yang charged that debt to the northeast and treated it as the standing disgrace of the new dynasty; in the eighth year of Daye (612) a host of one million one hundred and thirty thousand men had been broken at the Salu and had brought back only a few thousand survivors, and that page was the hardest he could show to his ministers. The stated reason for a second campaign was that Goguryeo was obstructing: it did not obey the summons, it held the Yalu and the mountains of Liaodong, it controlled the corridor into the Bohai and the Jiewei, and the envoys and goods of the Sui all had to pass through its territory, so that such a border kingdom could not be tolerated. But the more immediate reason lay inside the realm: after years of great levies Hebei and Shandong were exhausted, there was drought and sickness in Shandong and bandits in every county, and the Sui court needed a victory to prove the worth of its military system. And the emperor's own nature would not accept waiting another year: at the end of the Kaihuang era he had told his ministers that if the use of troops were properly arranged, moving mountains and draining seas would be easy, and that a small kingdom was plainly easier still. So the army marched in the first month, nominally two hundred thousand strong, on the road of crushing the enemy by weight of numbers. The flaw in the estimate lay in the same place: the Sui court still believed Goguryeo was soft and waiting to be taken, and had forgotten the two things that had mattered most the year before, that the siegecraft was not skilled enough and that the supply line was stretched far too long.
impact: 這一役的後果，要放到四年後隋朝覆亡的長鏈上才看得出。第一，大業九年（613）本來就是隋朝的轉捩點：七月楊玄感在黎陽起兵，旬日聚眾十萬，河北山東群盜並起，隋廷被迫從東北抽身回防，兩線同時失血。第二，煬帝不甘心，於大業十年（614）三征高句麗，仍無功而還；大業十一年（615）再御駕渡遼河，屯於睹簽村，遭高句麗伏擊大敗，隋軍連營潰散，僅以數百人護駕而還。這一次才是隋軍在東北戰線上真正的崩潰，也把煬帝最後一點銳氣耗盡；關中饑荒愈演愈烈，煬帝終於遷都江都，兩年後江都之變，隋亡。第三，對高句麗而言，613年守住平壤是一場慘勝：國土完整，代價是國力被反覆消耗，七年後仍要硬擋隋煬帝傾國而來，最終總章元年（668）為唐所滅。第四，往遠處看，隋廷連年把河北山東抽空，東北亞的權力真空由渤海、靺鞨、高句麗分占，而唐王朝日後要以另一種方式重新處理同一片山地與天險。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign only become visible when it is set in the long chain that ends with the fall of the Sui four years later. First, the ninth year of Daye (613) was in any case a turning point for the dynasty: in the seventh month Yang Xuanggan rose at Liyang, gathered a hundred thousand men within ten days, and bandits broke out in numbers all over Hebei and Shandong, so that the Sui court was forced to pull troops back from the northeast to guard the interior, and bled in two places at once. Second, the emperor would not accept it. In the tenth year of Daye (614) he mounted a third campaign against Goguryeo and returned without result; in the eleventh year (615) he crossed the Liao river in person and camped at the village of Dujian, where he was ambushed and beaten badly, the Sui columns dissolving and only a few hundred men escorting the imperial carriage back. That was the real collapse of the Sui army on the northeastern front, and it spent the last of the emperor's sharpness. Famine in the passes grew worse, the emperor finally moved the capital to Jiangdu, and two years later the coup at Jiangdu destroyed the dynasty. Third, for Goguryeo the holding of Pyongyang in 613 was a costly victory: the territory was kept intact, at the price of a national strength worn down by repeated effort, and seven years later the kingdom still had to hold off Yang of Sui coming with everything he had, until it was destroyed by the Tang in the first year of Zongzhang (668). Fourth, in the longer run, the Sui court drained Hebei and Shandong year after year, the vacuum of power in Northeast Asia was divided among the Bohai, the Jiewei and Goguryeo, and the Tang court would later have to deal with the same mountains and the same natural barriers by a different route.
result: 結局是又一次的大敗，而且敗得比上一年更沒有面子。平壤沒有攻下，沿線城邑沒有攻下，隋軍自九軍渡鴨綠水到退回渡口，沒有一場決定性的勝利；圍城月餘不下、築土山十九日徒費萬億、糧盡而退，遇雨缺糧，追兵及於清河，最後靠玄菟郡長史史祥在淺水營築城拒守，才把陸續退回的殘部收攏渡回鴨綠水西岸。朝廷的處置是：煬帝聞報大怒，罷諸將，貶宇文述、封德彝等官，樂浪道主將于仲文以逗留遭劾罷官，高句麗譯使乙支文德那套詐降，連隋廷自己也難以自圓其說；同時楊玄感在黎陽的起兵逼得煬帝提前回師，東北的仗再也打不下去。收穫是零：沒有拔下一城，沒有建立一個郡縣，河北山東的民力與府庫又一次被掏空，隋朝在東北方向的軍事信用徹底破產。此後仍有大業十年的三征與大業十一年的渡遼河之敗，但從這一趟起，隋朝已把最後一次武力解決東北問題的機會用盡，而高句麗保住了國土與國力，成為在東北亞維持百餘年的強國。
resultEn: The outcome was another defeat, and a more humiliating one than the year before. Pyongyang was not taken and the towns along the line were not taken; from the moment nine armies crossed the Yalu to the moment the survivors regained the crossing, there was not one decisive success. The siege of the city went on for more than a month without success, nineteen days of assault against the rampart of earth were spent for nothing at a cost reckoned in tens of millions, the grain ran out and the army withdrew, and then came rain, hunger and sickness, with the pursuit close behind at the Qinghe; only the fort that Shi Xiang, governor of Xuantu Commandery, built at the camp of Qianshui allowed the stragglers to be gathered up and carried back across the Yalu. The court's response was as follows: the emperor was furious, the generals were dismissed, Yuwen Shu and Feng Deyi and the rest were demoted, Yu Zhongwen of the Lelang road was impeached for delay and stripped of his command, and the Sui court could not even make the story of Yizhi Wende's feigned surrender square with itself. At the same time Yang Xuanggan's revolt at Liyang forced the emperor to turn back early, and the war in the northeast could not be carried on. The gain was nothing: not one city was taken, not one commandery or county was founded, the strength and the stores of Hebei and Shandong were emptied for the third time, and the Sui military reputation in the northeast was ruined beyond repair. There would still be the third campaign of the tenth year of Daye and the defeat beyond the Liao river in the eleventh, but from this expedition onward the Sui had spent its last chance of settling the northeastern question by force, while Goguryeo kept its territory and its strength and remained the strong power in Northeast Asia for another century.
